items.question: What number of brahmins makes a village classified as inferior?
premises: A village with two hundred thousand brahmins is inferior.
Six hundred thousand brahmins marks a middle-best village.
items.inference: Thus an inferior village is endowed with two hundred thousand brahmins.
uncertainties: The exact scope of bhūsura and village classification is unclear.
items.plain_english: A village endowed with two hundred thousand brahmins is called inferior.
